## INT. SAYE'S HOUSE - KITCHEN - BEFORE DAWN

DR SAYE, fifties, grey and tidy, fully dressed at four in the morning, looks at the three of them on her step. At the blood. Then, for a long moment, at the flask.

@SAYE
Kitchen.

A kitchen with nothing of anybody in it. No photographs. No magnets on the fridge. A pot of mint on the windowsill, and that is all.

Jude on the table. Saye's medical case open. Iona holds the lamp.

Saye cuts Jude's shirt away, cleans the wound, works down his chest with quick flat hands. Stops at an old white scar low on his belly.

@SAYE
Was your appendix on the left?

@JUDE
They didn't let me watch.

She puts her stethoscope on his chest. Listens. Frowns. Moves it to the other side. Listens there a long time.

@IONA
That's his right. The scar. It's where it should be.

Saye looks up at her.

@SAYE
Hold up your right hand.

Iona holds it up. Saye holds up hers.

They stand facing each other across the table like a woman and her reflection, each with the wrong hand in the air.

@SAYE
That is your left.

@IONA
It's my right.

Saye's wedding ring. On her right hand.

Iona looks down at her own ring, on her own left hand.

Across the room Eli twists the cap of a water bottle. It will not give. He stops. Twists it the other way. It comes off.

Saye is watching him. He sees her watching. Her hand moves towards the flask on the counter.

@ELI
Don't open the flask.

Saye sets her scissors down.

She goes to the windowsill, tears a leaf from the pot of mint, and holds it out.

@SAYE
Chew that.

Iona chews it.

Her face changes.

@SAYE
What does it taste of?

@IONA
(not steady)
Not mint.

@SAYE
Nothing has happened to the mint. Nothing has happened to the street signs either.

She picks up her phone.

@IONA
Who are you calling?

@SAYE
The hospital. Then the police.

Iona moves between her and Eli.

@SAYE
Look at Jude. I cannot finish that here.

She waits until Iona steps aside.

@SAYE
Nobody leave this room.

> CUT TO BLACK.

= THE CATCH
